spec.title: Vector
spec.description: Vector log pipeline: throughput, sink health towards Elasticsearch, disk buffers and backlog, source lag, pod resources. Filter with cluster / pod / component variables.

spec.title: Pod restarts (1h)
spec.description: Container restarts of the vector container over the last hour. OOMKills show up here first.

spec.title: Events dropped/s (unintentional)
spec.description: Events a component discarded after retries were exhausted (non-retriable Elasticsearch item errors, for example a mapping conflict). Not buffer drops: the ES sinks use when_full: block.

spec.title: Disk buffers total
spec.description: Sum of on-disk sink buffers across the selected pods. Backlog waiting for Elasticsearch.

spec.title: Buffer fill (max)
spec.description: Fullest disk buffer among the selected pods. At 100 % the sink blocks its inputs (when_full: block).

spec.expr: max(vector_buffer_size_bytes{buffer_type="disk", cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"} / vector_buffer_max_size_bytes{buffer_type="disk", cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"})

spec.title: Source lag p95
spec.description: Age of a kubernetes_logs event when Vector reads it (file timestamp to ingest). Grows when sinks apply backpressure.

spec.expr: sum by (component_kind, component_id) (rate(vector_component_received_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (component_kind, component_id) (rate(vector_component_sent_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (component_kind, component_id) (rate(vector_component_received_event_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (component_kind, component_id) (rate(vector_component_sent_event_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Component utilization
spec.description: Fraction of time a component is busy (gauge 0-1, averaged over the selected pods). A sink near 1 is the bottleneck; a source near 1 with low sink utilization means the source is starved by backpressure.

spec.expr: avg by (component_kind, component_id) (vector_utilization{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"})

spec.title: Errors by component and type
spec.description: Elasticsearch item-level rejections (es_rejected_execution_exception, 429) arrive inside a HTTP 200 bulk response and are counted here as request_failed / http_response, not in the HTTP status panel.

spec.expr: sum by (component_kind, component_id, error_type) (rate(vector_component_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

spec.title: Discarded events by component
spec.description: intentional=true: filtered by design (throttle, route). intentional=false: lost after retries were exhausted.

spec.expr: sum by (component_id, intentional) (rate(vector_component_discarded_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_kind=~"$component_kind", component_type=~"$component_type", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

spec.title: HTTP request RTT p95
spec.description: Time for one bulk request to Elasticsearch. Minutes here mean the ES write thread pool is queueing.

spec.title: Adaptive concurrency limit (mean)
spec.description: ARC controller: the request concurrency Vector allows itself towards the sink, and what is actually in flight. The limit collapses to 1 when the sink answers slowly or with errors.

spec.expr: sum by (component_id) (rate(vector_adaptive_concurrency_limit_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (component_id) (rate(vector_adaptive_concurrency_limit_count{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (component_id) (rate(vector_adaptive_concurrency_in_flight_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (component_id) (rate(vector_adaptive_concurrency_in_flight_count{cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Disk buffer size by sink
spec.description: Bytes waiting on disk per sink, summed over the selected pods.

spec.title: Disk buffer fill ratio by sink (max over pods)
spec.description: 1.0 = buffer full: the sink blocks upstream (when_full: block) and the kubernetes source stops reading.

spec.expr: max by (component_id) (vector_buffer_size_bytes{buffer_type="disk", cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"} / vector_buffer_max_size_bytes{buffer_type="disk", cluster=~"$cluster", pod=~"$pod", component_id=~"$component_id"})

spec.title: Buffer in / out (events/s)
spec.description: in > out: the backlog grows. out > in: it drains.

spec.title: Memory working set vs limit
spec.description: Vector holds in-flight batches and retry state in memory. Under sustained sink errors the working set climbs to the limit and the pod is OOMKilled.
